item.title: Didgeridoo 0.6.0
item.description:
• The Audio Unit has a window of its own in the host: the app's panel, with the Program menu and the knobs of Mouth, Lips and Rhythm. The knobs follow the host's automation, and turning one can be recorded as automation.
  • New knob Octave (−2 to +2) in the Rhythm panel. At 0, where it rests, the instrument plays two octaves lower than version 0.5.0 did, so that a didgeridoo's range sits around middle C; +2 is the old pitch. Projects saved with 0.5.0 sound two octaves lower until Octave is set to +2. This is a deliberate difference from the MPC plugin "Didgeridoo".
  • The keyboard strip in the app's window now shows C2–C6.
  • The app's icon covers its whole tile; macOS 26 and later no longer put it on a light plate.
